# Daily Report — 2026-08-04

## Task Completed
Added `list_ci_audit_history` tool — a deduplicated audit-history shortcut for a
single CI. Given a `ci_sys_id`, the tool fetches field-level change records from
`sys_audit` (newest-first) and deduplicates them by `field_name`, keeping only the
most recent change per field. This gives a concise snapshot of every field that has
changed and its current audited value, without wading through the full raw audit trail.

Optional filters: `ci_table` (default `cmdb_ci`), `field_name`, `changed_by`,
`changed_after`/`changed_before`, `limit`, `offset`. Registered in
`system_administrator` and `full` packages.
